result:
The decisive mistake was Verification_Expert's step 5. The search results contained no average ratings, yet it declared that Mammoth Terraces, Old Faithful, Fountain Paint Pots, Mount Washburn, and West Thumb Geyser Basin all had ratings "well above 4.5." It also dropped Trout Lake and Elephant Back without justification, even though Trout Lake had about 88 reviews and was described as excellent for younger kids. Its approval then locked in an unsupported final list that the rest of the team accepted.

STEP: 5
